description: Vibe Lab combines a project tracker for vibe-coded side projects with an AI experiment journal, so every project keeps its own log of what you tried and what worked. It includes a project board, a gallery, a recent-experiments view, a weekly digest, a lessons library that collects anything you mark as worth saving, and bonus prompts. It comes pre-seeded with example projects and experiments so you can see it in action.
